chunks: Know that God enlivens the earth even after it has died. We have explained to you clearly Our signs that you may understand.
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran use the revival of the earth as a sign for human understanding?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hadid serves as a macrocosmic sign (ayah) linking the physical resurrection of barren land to the spiritual resurrection of the heart through divine guidance. It underscores the principle that rational contemplation (ta'aqqul) is the primary means by which believers recognize the Creator's power, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the unity of intellect and revelation.
